subject: marginals/Berechnung der AME für eine Probit-Regression in lavaan

messages.author: c6f28689f4eb93ea
messages.subject: marginals/Berechnung der AME für eine Probit-Regression in lavaan
parts:
Hi group members, 

I did a path analysis in lavaan (two equations) with endogen discrete Variables (0/-Variables). The modell worked and I got the results already. My problem is: I miss the AME/marginals which are corresponding to the regression coefficients. The regression coefficients are part of the ouput, but not the marginals. The marginals are more concrete - you can interpret them as probabilities -  a standard concept of Logit/Probit analysis. Does anybody know the command for getting the marginals/AME in lavaan (whether you compute a path model only with manifest variables like in my case or  with latent variables, but: with discret endogenous variables)?

Thank you very much
Jürgen Schmidt
